name: Jack-o-Lantern

attributes.attribute: an alternate name for Tine Ghealáin, a nighttime light often over marshy ground

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Jack-o-Lantern is another name for Tine Ghealáin. See also Jack of the Lantern. Scholars treat the figures as one being. The name marks a nighttime light often shown over marshy ground.
objective: Document Jack-o-Lantern as another name for Tine Ghealáin.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Jack-o-Lantern entry.
